deviations.description: Source lib/engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh unconditionally at the top (matching derived-artifact-probe-lib.sh's own convention) and implement Decision 2's fallback entirely at the WORK (h) call site via a subshell-captured, 2>/dev/null-guarded function call
deviations.reason: An unconditional top-level source cannot itself 'fall back' on a missing file -- it would simply leave the function undefined and continue (no set -e in this script). Decision 2's actual fallback therefore has to live at the call site (engine_written_paths_json="$(engine_written_state_paths 2>/dev/null)" || engine_written_paths_json=""), which also correctly catches the 'function undefined' failure mode, not just an empty/malformed JSON result.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — Decision 2 fallback implemented at the WORK (h) call site rather than at the (unconditional, matching-sibling-style) top-level source line itself)*
